chunks: Whoever carries his deceased brother by the four sides of the bier, Allah will erase forty major sins from him.

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir عليه السلام
key_terms.أَخَاهُ: his brother, meaning a fellow believer

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for carrying a deceased believer’s bier on all four sides?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages participation in the funeral rites of a deceased believer, specifically carrying the bier from all four sides. It highlights a great spiritual reward: Allah erases forty major sins from the one who does so.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.458 - Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), said:
“Whoever carries their deceased brother on all four sides of the bier, Allah (swt) will erase forty major sins from them."
